decisions.summary: Bundled single-PR scope accepted for the cross-system adjudication provenance feature
decisions.reason: The change is one atomic behavior (weight-independence enforcement): provenance recording, the evidence-path warning, the judgment-DAG hard reject with override logging, and the environment decision fallback are mutually dependent parts of a single enforceCrossSystemAdjudicator code path introduced in src/adjudication.js and wired through one CLI subcommand set in src/cli.js. Splitting across PRs would leave an intermediate state where the judgment-DAG route rejects same-system adjudicators with no override or environment-decision escape hatch merged yet, which is worse than either all-in or none. Test coverage (unit, judgment, e2e) is likewise one coherent suite added in this diff; a reviewer reads the whole feature as one judgment call.
